bull.b: A large share of the multi-year product pipeline is already in mass production and over 40 design-win projects are live. That shifts revenue mix toward recurring product shipments, improves revenue visibility and reduces dependence on one-off licensing, supporting a steadier route to scale and breakeven.

Redemption of convertible debt and repayment of loans left the company with materially reduced leverage and positive equity. This improves financial flexibility to fund product scaling, absorb operational volatility and pursue R&D or M&A without immediate refinancing pressure, lengthening runway.

bull.t: Expanding RF opportunity and new markets
bull.b: Emerging RF/transceiver wins, a drone program and a pipeline of RF opportunities diversify revenue beyond core LTE-M/NB-IoT. New end-markets and 5G eRedCap roadmap can create higher-volume, longer-term revenue streams and reduce product concentration risk if execution continues.

bear.t: Negative operating cash flow & ongoing burn
bear.b: The company continues to consume cash from operations, with substantial YTD operating burn noted. Despite one-off investing proceeds, sustained negative operating cash flow threatens runway and makes the path to self-funded growth contingent on scaling product revenue and converting pipeline into predictable cash receipts.

bear.t: Reliance on licensing timing for upside
bear.b: Management's near-term outlook and break-even trajectory are contingent on closing multiple licensing deals. Such contracts are lumpy and timing‑sensitive, creating persistent revenue volatility risk and undermining forecastability until recurring product revenue alone can sustainably cover fixed costs.

Margins have compressed materially due to a higher mix of lower-margin product sales and the absence of prior high-margin licenses. Ongoing supply constraints (memory, silicon, packaging) can raise costs or limit shipments, and a structurally lower gross margin reduces operating leverage as revenue scales.
